scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently submitted a housing loan application and I'd like to know the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what is the interest rate I've been offered?
dialogue.agent: Your application for loan ID LOAN-01214 has been denied. This loan was not offered an interest rate because it was denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you please tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what type of loan product was I being considered for?
dialogue.agent: The principal reasons for denial were your debt-to-income ratio and credit history. You were being considered for a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user: I understand. Could you please explain what my debt-to-income ratio means in this context? Also, is there any way to appeal this decision or improve my chances of approval in the future?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. In your case, it was over 60%. I'm unable to discuss appeals or future approval chances.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for the information. <Neutral> The explanation about the debt-to-income ratio was helpful, but I wish there was more information about what I can do to improve my chances in the future.
